scope: Typed and manually selected passenger drop-offs in a real Edge browser on the integrated local staging release. The photographs and public passenger wording were previously seen. This is an engineering rehearsal. The photo observations were made by an AI reviewer.
coordinates: Original-image pixels measured from the upper left. Timings cover the browser action through the visible response and include polling. Saving records the passenger’s intended location.

restaurant.photo_review: Two visible parking stalls share the stripe under the original tap. The marked centre lane between the vehicles had no destination pin.
restaurant.first_staging_build: The original automatic restaurant wording produced a generic clarification without bay choices. The corrected release returned both bays; the initial and repeat times below are from the corrected release.

ui_regressions.coverage: Typed and reviewed-voice pending actions and races, prior point-only rendering, perspective polygons, shared boundaries, separately labelled taps, menu buttons, keyboard activation, tapping the polygon or its on-photo label, responsive layout, and zoom.

retained_ambiguity: The added restaurant request using 'nearest' still offered the two bays. This photo does not establish which bay is physically nearest to the restaurant.
limitations: Ordinary browser checks establish the displayed and saved destination for these photos and instructions. A driver must check current traffic, clearance and stopping rules.
